semantics.record_grain: One observation for one entity, metric definition, exact period, dimensions, unit and accounting basis in one source version.
semantics.period_policy: Use source dates and period kind. Do not substitute report year for observation period.
semantics.missing_policy: A missing row is not zero and does not prove non-disclosure in source material.
semantics.aggregation_policy: Do not sum different units, dimensions, periods or accounting bases without an explicitly validated rule.
semantics.state_policy: Candidate, task-reviewed and adopted are distinct. Read actual record/version review state.

access_methods.purpose: Resolve returned evidence IDs, then inspect original blocks and required context within the same source selection.

evidence_requirement.minimum: Frozen source identity and hash plus an original text span or table cell with headers, period, unit and necessary footnotes.
evidence_requirement.computed_values: Keep formula, operand record IDs and operand evidence; never label a computed result as a directly disclosed value.
evidence_requirement.unavailable_precision: Return an explicit locator limitation; do not invent character, cell or page coordinates.
